The dial features a central illustration of a bird (possibly a penguin or similar figure) and concentric rings of markings. There is a pointer hand indicating a reading. Above the main barometer, a portion of another similar instrument is visible. Below the main instrument, there is distorted, illegible text that appears to be AI-generated gibberish.
